_comment: Festival and public-holiday dataset for ncal.
'fixed'    - same BS month/day every year. Rule-based, so correct for all years.
'lunar'    - tithi-based festivals, pinned to one BS year. These CANNOT be derived
from the BS_REFERENCE table and must be entered per year from an
authoritative panchanga (e.g. the Nepal Calendar Determination
'lunar_years_covered' is the inclusive [first, last] BS year range for which lunar
entries have been entered and verified. Leave it empty while 'lunar' is empty so
the UI can tell users that Dashain/Tihar dates are not available yet rather than
implying those years genuinely have no festivals.
